name: Institution for a Global Society Corporation
summary: Institution for a Global Society Corporation provides assessment and educational solutions worldwide. Its GROW360 is an AI-powered system that scientifically measures the competencies and characteristics of current or prospective employees, supporting organizational development and predictive talent acquisition for large companies and the public sector. It also runs a service that pairs recruitment opportunities with reskilling for professionals at no cost. Dating from 2010, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
